per_memo_changeable.description: Generate-time loop only (not a Word for-loop). Length N → emit N bordered photo+caption tables by cloning the template prototype.

caption.notes: Written as plain Word text; human-editable after generation.

images.notes: Optional multi-image-under-one-caption extension evidenced in SM-001–003; not the blank-template default.

generation_rules: Read photo_blocks length N from the memo assignment.
Clone the single prototype table in site-memo-template.doc N times (remove prototype if N=0).
Each clone: 1 column × 2 rows; borders Single / 0.5; row0=image, row1=plain caption text.
Do not lock captions or protect the document.

Photo of Light Fitting and trunking clash with new installation

Photo of R/F Cooling Tower Area (Low Zone)

editability_rules: Output unlocked .doc (not .docx for this project; not PDF-only).
Use plain {{placeholders}} for per-memo fields; project-locked defaults as literals.
Use photo_blocks[] length to drive how many photo border tables are generated.
Do not lock content controls or restrict editing.
Humans must be able to edit all text (including captions) and replace photos after generation.
Match SM-005 photo table borders: Single / 0.5.
